title: Will the #1 Movie on Netflix have at least 12 million views?
rules: If the #1 Movie on Netflix has at least 12 million views on the chart published on Oct 27, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
This market specifically encompasses the number of “Views” (not hours viewed) of
the top Movie ranked on Netflix’s weekly charts for Global "Movies  | English"  chart.

The Netflix charts are updated on Tuesday. Therefore, the market will close at 11:59 PM ET the day before. The chart published on Oct 27, 2026 will be for the week ending the previous Sunday.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Netflix. Any references to Netflix, or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Netflix and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: FlixPatrol shows Ben Affleck's Animals still dominating Netflix's global movie rankings on Oct 19 (859 points vs 298 for #2), which usually means a weekly total well above 12M even in a third chart week. Tyler Perry's Doing Life is a second possible top film, and the new Oct 21–23 releases look modest. Historically most weeks' #1 English film clears 12M, but weak weeks fall to 8–11M, and Animals will be losing viewers.
blind.falsifier: Netflix's Oct 27 chart shows the #1 English film (likely Animals or Doing Life) under 12.0M views because Animals dropped sharply in week three and no new release took off.

final.reasoning: The market at 0.845 is above my 0.74, and traders may know Animals' actual week-two views, which I couldn't find. I'm moving toward their price, and the remaining gap is too small and uncertain to bet NO.
